title: Great Barcelona Night with Alessandro the Great
text:
Great way to get to learn historical facts and get to know the local area. The area is fascinating and the tour guide, Alessandro,  was so energetic and knowledgeable. 
The description on the website needs to reflect that there is only one bar stop.
author: Barbara_V

title: Great night with locals in Barcelona
text: My wife and I had the absolute pleasure of joining Alan on the Drinks & Bites in El Born Tour, and it was hands down one of the highlights of our trip to Barcelona! Alan was the perfect guide—knowledgeable, engaging, and effortlessly personable. He struck the perfect balance of sharing just enough history to enrich the experience without overwhelming the fun and laid-back vibe. While the bites were enjoyable, the true stars of this tour were the delicious cocktails and the vibrant, unique bars Alan introduced us to. title: Great fast, yet fun tour of Barcelona!
text: Our family of 8 flew into Barcelona the night before a cruise.  We had only a short time to see the City.  Our tour guide Octavio met us at our hotel and we had a great walking tour.  Six of our family members were ages 24-30 and they really enjoyed and related to Octavio.  Since we were late in arriving and hungry Octavio called a restaurant, made reservations, and took us to enjoy Tapas.  It was very busy on a Saturday night but we were immediately seated at a lovely table.  Octavio explained all about the foods and ordered for us. title: Barcelona private city tour
text: We thought it would be nice to schedule a stroll around the gothic quarter on the evening of our arrival day. Boy are we glad we did!!  We met up with Sebastian and strolled for 2 hours. The history he told us was outstanding. It was clear to see his love for Barcelona. You won’t be disappointed. Meeting point directions are east with google maps.
author: Sandra_D

title: Amazing
text: Alan was a fantastic guide. It was a magical evening w/Alan, as he showed us a different side of Barcelona. Learned a lot about Barcelona!!

title: Great Evening in Barcelona
text: I had a great time touring the gothic quarter with Karim- thank you for a fun evening in Barcelona! It was great to do it on my first evening in the city and get to understand the neighborhood. Thanks Karim!

title: Great introduction on night one !
text:
What a tour, what a guide. Very smart.
Really set the stage for my visit to Barcelona.
I got to see places I would have never discovered on my own.

title: Very easy going, interesting and enjoyable evening
text:
We absolutely loved our evening with Gonzalo. As a local he was able
to explain some very interesting history about locations and the
origins of place names and customs. These were all things that we
would not have discovered otherwise, and then of course, the best part
is that all of this takes place over the course of a couple of hours
exploring the hidden culinary gems of the back streets of El Born
